::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## A note before you begin

This is a **self-guided journey** designed to be done without a counselor or facilitator present. It moves intentionally slowly and repeats important reminders because reflection is the point, not speed.

**What this guide is:** a space to reflect, understand, and practice; a shared language for future conversations.

**What this guide is not:** a test of who is more mature, a place to resolve every conflict, or a tool to fix your spouse.

> *If you finish this guide knowing more about your spouse but less about yourself, we missed the point.*
:::

<p class="section-label">Group materials</p>

After completing the four days together, separate group guides help husbands and wives deepen their reflection honestly, with peers who share their experience. An [activity sheet](activity-sheet.html) summarises all four days on a single printable page.

<p style="margin-top:2rem;color:#8A7D6A;font-size:0.82rem;">This guide is designed for growth, not crisis intervention. If you or your spouse are experiencing abuse, severe conflict, or mental health challenges, please seek support from a licensed counselor before using self-guided materials.</p>
